ranked.headline: Single-cell profiles are used to infer regulatory activity and cell-state programs
ranked.summary: Single-cell and nuclear atlases, dynamical models and splicing-aware readouts now support inference of regulatory states across tissues and conditions.

ranked.headline: Open-source software standardises omics and imaging analysis steps across data types
ranked.summary: Installable modular packages now span preprocessing, metabolomics, proteomics and single-cell workflows, easing reproducible multimodal analysis.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based models predict protein solubility, aggregation, and immunogenicity
ranked.summary: Large experimental datasets and energy benchmarks now test sequence and structure models against measured folding, aggregation, and immunogenicity outcomes.

ranked.headline: Dynamical models infer cell-state trajectories and gene regulation from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Temporal models of aging and cell-state change are converging on single-cell and population-scale data.

ranked.headline: Multimodal fusion of language-model and structure features for biomolecular prediction
ranked.summary: Protein and language-model embeddings are increasingly fused with structural, graph, and spectral data for biomolecular prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Scalable sequence-based tools for microbial, plant, and viral genome analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications describe alignment-free, compression-based, and index-based methods for scaling genome sequence analysis.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware generative models steer protein, antibody and ligand design
ranked.summary: Generative models now incorporate explicit structural guidance and iterative feedback across protein, antibody, and small-molecule design.

ranked.headline: LLM agents are being tested for single-cell and spatial transcriptomic annotation
ranked.summary: Multi-agent and lightweight open-weight LLM agents are now being evaluated for cell and region annotation in transcriptomic data.

ranked.headline: Learned models extend access to biomolecular kinetics and ensembles
ranked.summary: Physics-informed ML, learned samplers, and coarse-grained models now target kinetics and free energies drawn from MD data.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict binding, synergy, and toxicity from structure and data
ranked.summary: Graph and deep networks now predict ligand sites, mutational binding energy shifts, and dose-resolved toxicity from sequence, structure, and assay data.

ranked.headline: Deep sequence models for regulatory DNA: interpretability gains and cross-species limits
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool test whether deep DNA sequence models can be both predictive and mechanistically legible.

ranked.headline: Graph models encode molecular and biological structure for drug discovery tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair graph architectures with knowledge graphs and sequence embeddings to improve drug repositioning and interaction prediction.

ranked.headline: Spatial transcriptomics methods target niches, neighborhoods, and metabolic crosstalk
ranked.summary: High-resolution spatial platforms such as Xenium, MERFISH, and Visium HD now demand niche-aware tools for domain, neighborhood, and perturbation analysis.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale tools for assembly, metagenome binning, and microbial reference resources
ranked.summary: Large public genome collections, such as ~170,000 bacterial genomes in CABBAGE, demand scalable curation and analysis tools.

ranked.headline: Self-supervised and foundation models advance tissue segmentation in histopathology
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend label-efficient and foundation-model approaches to whole-slide, 3D tumour, and spatial transcriptomics segmentation tasks.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale assemblies paired with comparative genomics across eukaryotic lineages
ranked.summary: Recent reference assemblies for tunicates, wild tobacco, oat and sugar beet enable comparative and population-level analyses of eukaryotic genomes.

ranked.headline: Neural models segment and filter raw microscopy and cryo-EM data
ranked.summary: Deep models now act directly on raw cryo-ET, cryo-EM, and microscopy data, reducing dependence on hand-engineered intermediate measurements.

ranked.headline: Chromatin profiling links regulatory elements, genome contacts, and disease variants
ranked.summary: Single-cell chromatin and multi-omic datasets now resolve regulatory activity, QTL effects, and off-target artifacts at cell-type resolution.

ranked.headline: Pretrained language model embeddings reused to predict variant and target effects
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one publication apply DNABERT, Sentence-BERT, and BERT-based protein models to regulatory, disease, and degradation prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking docking and automated workflows for biomolecular complex modeling
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks test structure-based docking and simulation pipelines on PROTAC ternary complexes and the MALAT1 lncRNA.

ranked.headline: Graph-based fusion methods integrate spatial omics with histology and multiomics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply graph and contrastive learning to fuse heterogeneous omics and histology for domain identification and survival.

ranked.headline: Local rules and disorder set emergent dynamics in tissues and condensates
ranked.summary: Recent preprints link local interaction rules and random connectivity to emergent dynamic observables in tissues, condensates and cellular assemblies.

ranked.headline: Constrained and structured parameter inference for biological dynamical models
ranked.summary: Recent work ties parameter estimation to model structure, steady-state constraints, and tracer-based model reduction in biological systems.

ranked.headline: Structured models of immunity loss, reinfection and viral budding kinetics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints add explicit age structure for waning and reinfection and an intermediate budding state in place of instantaneous transitions.

ranked.headline: MD simulations resolve dynamic conformational routes in ezrin, CENP-A, SERINC3 and ExsA
ranked.summary: Simulations now trace how local perturbations propagate through macromolecular assemblies, adding dynamic routes beyond static structures.

ranked.headline: Simulation, modification mapping, and probe design tools advance RNA sequencing workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication address computational validation of RNA sequencing workflows, from modification mapping to annotation bias.

ranked.headline: Reference-free and methylation-aware tools refine long-read genome assembly and phasing
ranked.summary: Long-read sequencing now supports reference-free misassembly detection, methylation-guided phasing, and assembly benchmarks at about 12x coverage.

ranked.headline: Allele reconstruction from Nanopore amplicon reads without target input
ranked.summary: Target-free allele reconstruction from nanopore amplicons and tree-based haplotype modeling are now being validated on real and simulated genomic datasets.

ranked.headline: Topological and geometric tests of higher-order structure in fMRI and functional data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published comparison apply topological and geometric methods to test and compare higher-order interactions in fMRI signals.

ranked.headline: Gut bacterial genomes reveal defense systems, bacteriocins, and Klebsiella diversity
ranked.summary: Large-scale genome collections from human gut microbiomes now enable systematic mapping of phage-defense, antimicrobial, and pathogen diversity.

ranked.headline: EEG complexity, mechanistic modelling and adaptive stimulation track brain states
ranked.summary: Complexity measures, individual-level models and adaptive stimulation now link EEG rhythms to sleep, disorders of consciousness and Fragile X.

ranked.headline: Computational tools map RNA processing and ribozyme targeting in human cells
ranked.summary: Sequence and structure-based computational methods now resolve 3'UTR isoform diversity, intronic polyadenylation, and ribozyme target sites from RNA data.

ranked.headline: Emergent self-inhibition and survival boundaries in ecological and cellular models
ranked.summary: Three November 2025 preprints model stability, survival boundaries and emergent agency across ecosystems, cells and agent collectives.

ranked.headline: MD simulations map antibody CDR loop flexibility and spike allosteric rewiring
ranked.summary: Large-scale simulation now resolves loop flexibility in antibodies and TCRs and variant-specific allosteric networks in SARS-CoV-2 spike.

ranked.headline: Canalization opens a coherence gap between attractor stability and basin size in GRNs
ranked.summary: Quantitative design rules and in silico lineage simulations now test how network topology and feedback strength govern regulatory state transitions.

ranked.headline: Network feedback governs cancer cell state plasticity and hybrid EMT phenotypes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple mechanistic ODE and EMT models with intracellular viscosity measurements to link network structure to cancer cell states.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomes trace land colonization, limb elongation, and mammalian speciation
ranked.summary: Recent comparative genomics at broad phylogenetic scales links genomic change to major evolutionary transitions across animals, gibbons, and placental mammals.
